ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; surface is approximately 90-95% low-intensity dark pixels with isolated high-intensity white pixels at margins and scar sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters (blobs) are mapped to the extreme distal tips (lateral margins). Secondary high-contrast linear streaks mapped to the mid-lower right lobe and mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within its local bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Pixel amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the distal tips, while the trailing edge closer to the notch shows lower-amplitude, smoother variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curve trajectory; the lobes exhibit a distinct upward and outward sweep from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-density clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups located at both the left and right distal tips, corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two primary white linear disruptions: one long diagonal rake mark on the lower right lobe and several shorter, fainter horizontal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the lateral margins and visible white rake marks/scarring on the right lobe surface.
